data.name: Kalandi
data.gender_notes: Kalandi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kalandi is the name of a Hindu goddess, a form of Goddess Saraswati. She is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, learning, and arts. In Hindu mythology, Kalandi is often depicted holding a veena (a musical instrument) and is considered to be the source of creative arts and learning. The name Kalandi carries the meaning “Goddess of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kalandi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kalandi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalandi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Kalandi holds immense cultural significance in Indian society. She is revered in many parts of India, particularly in South India, as a guardian of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. Her image can be found in various temples, artworks, and literature. The trials and tribulations faced by Goddess Kalandi in Hindu mythology, including surviving through fire and poison, demonstrate her unwavering devotion towards knowledge, emphasizing its importance in human life.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Kalandi represents the inner promise of wisdom, knowledge, and inspiration. She is a symbol of wisdom, encouraging individuals to seek self-improvement and personal growth. Her close association with the goddess Saraswati highlights the importance of inner knowledge and spiritual awareness in achieving enlightenment. Hindu devotees turn to Kalandi when theyseek guidance in academic pursuits or any domain requiring mastery of skills and knowledge. Ultimately, Kalandi embodies the eternal quest for wisdom and knowledge, urging us to embrace the journey to self-discovery and fulfillment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kalandi signifies the radiant, golden hue of the autumn moon. It is a name of divine grace and beauty, symbolizing the illumination of the soul during spiritual awakening.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Kalandi is a name of a river in India, mentioned in the Mahabharata. The name Kalandi carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: River Kalandi is a tributary that flows into the river Godavari in Maharashtra, India.
